statements.status_notes: org.json 20240303 is embedded inside com.databricks:databricks-jdbc 3.4.5 (the latest release) as relocated classes, so it cannot be overlaid from Flyway lib/. The fix is in org.json 20260719. Waiting for an upstream databricks-jdbc release that bundles a fixed org.json.
